fields.statement: QA at cf68954a8, scratch-built rhiza (go build -trimpath): rhiza run note journalled with session/role/leaf from env and via --run prefix and api call run.note; run status human '## Notes' and --json notes oldest first with role and leaf; empty/space-only, \n, \r, 201-rune (200 é accepted), missing text and no RHIZA_RUN all exit 2 with nothing journalled; unknown run exit 4; --dry-run writes nothing. Scoped tests: internal/run -run TestNote, internal/api -run TestRunNote, TestScripts/run-note and describe-golden pass.

QA at cf68954a8, scratch-built rhiza driving a leaves run with fake rex/claude: verifier journalling two findings (multi-line, 250+ chars with leading/trailing spaces) then exiting 0 gives the attempt-2 builder a prompt quoting both byte for byte, the inspect-the-working-tree and address-every-finding-as-written lines; a no-findings failure quotes 'verifier failed: exit 1'; attempt 1 has no retry section; three failures give no fourth builder and the leaf fails. FAIL: a verifier that journals findings and then exits 1 gives a retry prompt saying it journalled no findings (qa finding f1, internal/run/leaves.go:478).

QA at cf68954a8, same scratch leaves run: after a builder and a verifier ran rhiza run note, later builder and verifier prompts (same and next leaf, retries too) end with 'Notes from earlier sessions of this run:' and both '- <note>' lines oldest first; the first builder (no notes yet) has no heading; a spawned builder child's brief.md carries the notes after the caller's brief, a spawned check-plan child's carries none. Scoped tests internal/api -run 'TestLeafPrompt|TestRunSpawn', internal/run -run TestRenderSpawnBrief, TestScripts/run-spawn pass.

QA at cf68954a8, scratch-built rhiza guide: builder and verifier topics carry `rhiza run note "<learning>"` before session done; builder carries the update-landed-node-with-rhiza-set-or-raise-a-question rule; build-retry says findings are quoted verbatim in the prompt; conduct says the retry brief quotes findings verbatim and inspects the working tree; verifier keeps 'Never edit code'; no check-*, critic, plan-critic or fixer topic names `rhiza run note`. rhiza show of builder-topic, verifier-topic, build-retry-topic, conduct-skill matches. go test ./internal/guide/... and internal/api -run TestGuideInstall pass.
